as_told.title: Mario's account of starting Lazar's car for fear of a bomb

plain: This story is set in Las Vegas in 1989 and 1990 and comes from Bob Lazar, a man known for claims about secret work he says he did in the Nevada desert. Lazar says that his car, which he and others locked and checked, was found open again and again. He says they would lock it and test the door because it had happened before, and still it would be open. The fear, as told, was that someone had planted a bomb in the car. A guest named Luigi, on the same podcast episode hosted by Jesse Michels, retells it from a man named Mario, who he says was with Lazar all the time. According to Luigi, Mario said they were scared something would blow up, but he was going through such hard times that he did not care, so he told Lazar to stay back while he started the car himself. If true, it would suggest Lazar was being harassed or threatened over what he knew.
